title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Accepted-Claim Deductible
content:
**Clause.** On a Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage claim the coverage part follows the cause of loss: a collision with another vehicle or object, a rollover and a hit-and-run collision are collision, and every other cause is comprehensive. The option deductible is the collision deductible of the deductible option on a collision claim; on a comprehensive claim it is the glass repair deductible when the claim's estimate is glass repair, the glass replacement deductible when the estimate is glass replacement, and otherwise the comprehensive deductible. When the loss date falls before the date physical damage took effect on the vehicle, the loss falls in the automatic period of a newly acquired vehicle and the option deductible is the newly acquired vehicle deductible instead. The accepted-claim deductible is the option deductible, rounded to the cent.

## Figures and where they are read

| Figure | Record |
|---|---|
| Loss date and cause of loss | The claim's loss report |
| Glass work (repair, replacement, or none) | The claim's latest estimate |
| Date physical damage took effect, and the deductible option | The vehicle's physical damage coverage record |
| Collision, comprehensive, glass repair, glass replacement and newly acquired vehicle deductibles | The deductible option's schedule figures |

## Selection of the option deductible

| Loss date before the physical damage effective date | Coverage part | Glass work on the estimate | Option deductible |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Any | Any | Newly acquired vehicle deductible |
| No | Collision | Any | Collision deductible of the option |
| No | Comprehensive | Glass repair | Glass repair deductible of the option |
| No | Comprehensive | Glass replacement | Glass replacement deductible of the option |
| No | Comprehensive | None | Comprehensive deductible of the option |

## Worked figures (hypothetical option figures)

Take an option whose collision deductible is 1000, comprehensive deductible 500, glass repair deductible 0 and glass replacement deductible 500, and a newly acquired vehicle deductible of 500.

- A rollover on a vehicle whose physical damage took effect long before the loss: collision; the accepted-claim deductible is 1000.00.
- Hail damage with a body-shop estimate: comprehensive, no glass work; 500.00.
- A cracked windshield repaired: comprehensive, glass repair; 0.00.
- A windshield replaced: comprehensive, glass replacement; 500.00.
- A collision on a vehicle whose physical damage took effect three days after the loss date: the loss falls in the automatic period of a newly acquired vehicle; 500.00.
